definitions.explanation: A vast body of salt water, one of the major divisions of the world's oceans.

examples.japanese: {世界|せかい}には{五|いつ}つの{大洋|たいよう}がある。
examples.english: There are five oceans in the world.

examples.japanese: {大洋|たいよう}の{真|ま}ん{中|なか}で{嵐|あらし}に{遭|あ}った。
examples.english: We encountered a storm in the middle of the ocean.

notes:
{大洋|たいよう} refers to the major oceans of the world.

THE FIVE OCEANS:
- {太平洋|たいへいよう} (Pacific Ocean)
- {大西洋|たいせいよう} (Atlantic Ocean)
- {インド洋|いんどよう} (Indian Ocean)
- {北極海|ほっきょくかい} (Arctic Ocean)
- {南極海|なんきょくかい} (Southern/Antarctic Ocean)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {海|うみ}: sea, ocean (general)
- {海洋|かいよう}: ocean (scientific/formal)
